newsitem.title: UK: Boosey up as stake sale sparks bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Boosey up as stake sale sparks bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Boosey & Hawkes Plc leapt on Wednesday amid bid speculation after the musical instrument maker said 45.3 percent shareholder Carl Fischer Inc was considering selling its stake.

Boosey & Hawkes shares were up 40p at 837-1/2 by 1015 GMT in thin trade of just 237 shares. The company said the sale "as currently contemplated will...be accompanied by a public offer for all the remaining shares of B&H."
Under UK takeover rules, any buyer of 30 percent or more of a company's shares must make an offer for the remaining stock.

However, B&H added that it was considering "alternative proposals with its financial adviser Deutsche Morgan Grenfell that would provide shareholders of CFI with liquidity and shareholders of B&H with a continuing interest in a listed company."
It gave no details of what such proposals might be.
